name: dttbhutan-build-story
description: A Remotion case-study video about how DTT Bhutan was built.

scripts.web: ffmpeg -i out/dtt-bhutan-2min.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -af loudnorm=I=-15:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out/dtt-bhutan-2min-web.mp4 -y
scripts.web:tiktok: ffmpeg -i out/dtt-bhutan-tiktok.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 22 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out/dtt-bhutan-tiktok-web.mp4 -y
